major.summary: The strict event-time gate is underspecified for valid stored timestamp offsets, so a cross-provider implementation can release the wrong controller if it compares text values.
major.evidence: RecordGrowthSignalInput.capturedAt accepts any RFC 3339 offset and GrowthRunsService persists that input unchanged. Signal and Action timestamps are text without a canonical-UTC database constraint.
major.impact: The defining capturedAt > evaluatedAt rule could be decided by formatting rather than event time and differ between providers.
major.recommendation: Require UTC normalization at the pure policy boundary, provider-specific instant comparison in the atomic guard, malformed historical values failing closed, and offset-ordering tests on SQLite/D1 and PostgreSQL.

do_not_change.summary: Keep release lazy and scoped to the existing normalized controller ledger.
do_not_change.evidence: The plan retains immutable historical graphs, changes only controller_released_at and avoids adding a release hook to Action finalization.
do_not_change.impact: Preserves Action-lifecycle independence and avoids a new cross-feature mutation path.
do_not_change.recommendation: Retain this boundary when repairing the timestamp specification.

do_not_change.summary: Keep the cycle identity tied to the prior controller Recommendation rather than the losing candidate Signal.
do_not_change.evidence: The prior-Recommendation cycle key gives concurrent reopen candidates the same parent IDs while separating subsequent cycles.
do_not_change.impact: Preserves deterministic retry behavior and prevents losing candidates from creating independent graphs.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep this identity rule and guard every child insert by fact hash and release condition.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve the existing project-scoped exact-template Action qualification.
do_not_change.evidence: Current Work lookup derives the template key from the controller Signal and confirms the Action Recommendation ID; schema constraints are project scoped.
do_not_change.impact: Avoids foreign-project or unrelated Action release authority.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep project, Recommendation, template-key, evaluated-status and non-null evaluated-at predicates in preflight and atomic guards.
